'''Borke's Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Drepplin]], the capital city of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]].

Owned by [[Borke Valkanhayn]], its prices were average, making the cantina a place frequented, including by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Trask Lucan]]. It was primarily used to launder money from Borke's "importing" business. Initially there was a small danger from legal authorities, but Borke made a small "contribution" to the operating funds of several important officials and the problem went away.
